LAST STAND
A pixel-art zombie survivors game by Shan Platon.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Unzip the whole folder somewhere you can write to, such as Documents.
   Do not run the game from inside the zip.
2. Double-click LastStand.exe.

The game needs nothing else installed and makes no network connection.

WINDOWS WARNING
The program is not code signed, so Windows SmartScreen may say it
"protected your PC". Click "More info", then "Run anyway".

SAVES
Your best run is saved in a small file called laststand.save in the folder you
start the game from, which is normally the folder you unzipped it to.

PLAY IN A BROWSER INSTEAD
No download needed: https://shanpla.github.io/Last-Stand/

LICENSES
Last Stand is released under the MIT License (LICENSE.txt).
The licenses folder has the licenses of the parts it uses:
  PixelifySans-OFL.txt   the game font, SIL Open Font License
  raylib-LICENSE.txt     raylib, zlib license
  glfw-LICENSE.txt       GLFW, which raylib includes, zlib license
